timeHelp: Automatic follows the language: 12-hour in English, 24-hour in French.
workingDaysHelp: Pick the days you work. The pace of the weekly limit assumes you use the agent evenly across these days, and not at all on the others. Keep at least one day.
confirmSavedSearchDelete: Ask before deleting a saved search
keepAgentsRunningHelp: Off: when you quit Heidrun Code, Heidrun Code stops its Herdr session, and the agents stop. On: the agents continue to run, and Heidrun Code connects to the same session at the next start. The default Herdr session of your terminal is never stopped.
gitFetchLabel: Fetch the remote repository in the background
gitFetchHelp: Heidrun Code runs git fetch for the repository of the selected workspace, so that the two counts of the Git branch section of the status bar stay true. A fetch that fails shows nothing.
